name: Planetoid Formation
description: v1's recording scene (commented out in v1): 382 text pixels, each a deuteron-like pair of nucleons (12 quarks) with four electrons, under v1's step force map (pull inside half the 3 fm range, push outside), 1/d Coulomb and strong 1/d gravity that collapses the text into planetoids. v1 damped velocities by exp(-c·dt/m); the drag here is c divided by the mean quark mass (8). Initial state of v1's script, which later lowers the drag and raises gravity up to 16-fold.
